title: Experiment manifest
description: One manifest per numerical experiment. A numerical result may not be quoted anywhere without its manifest. Large intermediates belong outside Git; the manifest records hashes and the command that regenerates them.

code_commit.description: full SHA of the commit that produced the outputs

precision.description: float64 vs mpmath dps, per stage

tolerances.description: root and solver tolerances actually used

input_config.description: frequencies, angles, materials, geometry - everything needed to re-run

command.description: the exact shell command that regenerates every output

outputs.description: relative path -> sha256. Large files are NOT committed; they are regenerated by `command` and verified by hash.

convergence.description: resolution/step/precision sweep and the residual actually observed

policy: validation_status must be UNRESOLVED, never PASS, while any blocker in reports/PHASE_01C_OPEN_BLOCKERS.json that is listed in this experiment's dependency chain stays open
outputs must be hash-verified by validation/run_*.py before any result is quoted
the manifest is immutable once an approved baseline references it
